summary.name: Strategr
summary.one_liner: Strategr is a time-boxing planner for macOS that lets you structure your day into color-coded activities and time-boxed sessions.
use_cases: Structuring your workday into time-boxed sessions
Planning a daily schedule with color-coded activities
Getting notified before the next work session starts
Rearranging a day's sessions by dragging boundaries
Tracking which session is currently active
summary.what_it_does:
Strategr lets you create a list of daily activities, each with a color, and open an activities window with ⌘⇧A to add or edit them. You organize activities into time-boxed sessions by clicking and dragging across empty time slots on a time grid, and adjust grid settings with ⌘,. Sessions can be arranged by dragging their boundaries or whole blocks, with Shift to shift neighboring sessions and ⌥ to copy a session. The app tracks the current session, with ⌘/ jumping to the current time marker, and sends notifications 5 minutes before and at the start of a session.</what_it_does>
